messages:
Sam R: Hey folks — thinking we should move the weekly triage from Wed 11am to Tue 4pm PT. More overlap with APAC and avoids late Wed slams. Quick thumbs? :thinking:
Priya K: Tue 4pm might conflict with Synced Infra deploy review every other week. Can we alternate or make triage 30m? :confused:
Jorge L: I can cover Wed slots for the next 3 weeks if we need a gradual shift. Alternating weeks could work. :+1:
Elena M: If we move it, please update calendar and add a short pre-read doc link. Also suggest adding a 5m "owner rollcall" item so owners confirm coverage. :memo:
Marcus T: Proposal: keep 30m total. Agenda: 5m rollcall, 15m bug burn-down (hot lane), 5m RFC/design quick hits, 5m action items + owner assignment. Timebox strictly. :alarm_clock:
Sam R: Sounds good. Can we test Tue 4pm for two cycles, then evaluate? I'll post a poll. Also want to add a new fast lane for regressions (0-3 priority) — owners called out up front.
Priya K: If we alternate, add a calendar tag like [TRIAGE - ALT WEEK] so infra can plan. Also can we pin the backlog query? Current one pulls too many stale issues.
Jorge L: I'll update the saved JQL to exclude triaged-stale and add label "triage-candidate". Will drop link in calendar invite.
Elena M: Pre-read template (one-liner per ticket + owner + ETA) — I can paste into the invite body. Also +1 on regression fast lane.
DevBot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly triage meeting. Next run: 1897750000 (Tue 4pm PT test). Attached: poll results link (coming).
Marcus T: Quick note on owners: can we rotate primary every 2 weeks instead of every week? Less churn and better context.
Sam R: Two-week rotation seems reasonable. Jorge you good to be primary for the first two-week trial?
Jorge L: Yep, happy to take first two. I'll also shepherd the JQL and add the saved filter link.
Priya K: ✅ I'll coordinate the infra deploy weeks so we don't overlap.
Elena M: I'll update invite with pre-read template + filter link + agenda timeboxes. Draft invite text below: ```Agenda (30m):
- 5m Owner rollcall (who's primary/backup)
- 15m Hot lane & backlog triage (owners present short updates)
- 5m RFC/design quick checks (x-min per topic)
- 5m Actions + assignments (clear owners + ETA)
Pre-read: one-liner per ticket, owner, impact, ETA. Labels: triage-candidate, regression-fastlane.```
Sam R: Perfect. I'll send the test invite for Tue 4pm and mark it "trial (2 weeks)". If no major objections, we'll flip default after trial. :rocket:
Marcus T: :thumbsup: Also, can we add a one-click RSVP option for "I will be primary" so we avoid last-minute swaps? Maybe use emoji reactions on the invite message.
Elena M: Good idea. I'll include reaction instructions in the invite + a calendar note for backups.
Jorge L: Dropping the saved filter here: https://issues.internal/filters/9876 — excludes stale, adds label triage-candidate.
Sam R: Thanks all. Quick follow-up: everyone OK with the 5m RFC slot staying strictly for 1-2 high-priority checks only? No mini-design sessions.
Priya K: Agreed. Keep deep dives to separate design reviews.
Marcus T: Agreed. We need to protect the timebox.
DevBot: Poll posted: "Move triage to Tue 4pm PT for 2-week trial?" — please vote by EOD today.
Sam R: Closing — I'll post the test invite in ~30m. Ping me if you can't make either Tue 4pm trial. Thanks! :v:
